cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
mkdir -p backup_ib; cp classic_strategy.py runs.json config.json backup_ib/
f=classic_strategy.py
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL; exit 1; }
grep -c "be_intrabar=True" /tmp/new_$f
cat > /tmp/ib_stats.py <<'PY'
import sys,json,urllib.request
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8091/api/runs',timeout=60))
for k in ('me','bot','both'):
    a=d['accounts'][k]['account']; print(sys.argv[1],k,'equity',a['equity'],'taken',a['taken'],'closed',a['closed'],'wins',a['wins'],'be_true',sum(1 for t in a['log'] if t.get('be')))
print(sys.argv[1],'runs',len(d['runs']),'intrabar_on',sum(1 for r in d['runs'] if r['cfg'].get('be_intrabar')))
PY
python3 /tmp/ib_stats.py before
OWN_R=$(stat -c %u:%g runs.json); OWN_C=$(stat -c %u:%g config.json)
systemctl stop classicbot
cp /tmp/new_$f $f; chown tbot:tbot $f
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('runs.json',encoding='utf-8'))
n=0
for x in r:
    if not x['cfg'].get('be_intrabar'):
        x['cfg']['be_intrabar']=True; n+=1
json.dump(r,open('runs.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False)
c=json.load(open('config.json',encoding='utf-8')); c['be_intrabar']=True
json.dump(c,open('config.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False)
print('runs_changed',n,'of',len(r))
PY
chown $OWN_R runs.json; chown $OWN_C config.json
systemctl start classicbot
T0=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 50); do sleep 3; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo ready_in=$(( $(date +%s)-T0 ))s
python3 /tmp/ib_stats.py after
systemctl is-active classicbot
journalctl -u classicbot --since '3 min ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -c Traceback
